updateSteps: List current modules, ports and saved identifiers; keep identifiers stable so saved work and links still open.
Describe each process as an action and its result. Write what it receives and what it produces.
For each relationship, define the receiving task, expected result, timing and reason it is needed.
Check both endpoints and port types. Type compatibility is necessary; it does not prove the receiver uses the data.
Exercise the feature with known inputs. Check the receiving state or result, then repeat with the connection disabled and with invalid input.
Record observed delivery separately from a successful feature test. Missing, failed or untested behavior remains unverified; do not rename a proposal as a finished feature.
Choose a short action-based name, apply it to page navigation, module cards and connection descriptions, and preserve the old technical identifier.
Run model, browser, export, replay and accessibility checks. Fix failures and rerun affected checks before committing the change.
Export the purpose map and test evidence, push the checked changes, and publish only when hosting permits.
